name: articlewriter-obsidian
description: AI novel writing tool as an Obsidian plugin (file/folder create, open, save)

scripts.test: node -e "const { buildSync } = require('esbuild'); const { execFileSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const outdir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.tmp-tests'); const entries = ['src/prompts.test.ts', 'src/pipeline.test.ts', 'src/book_skill.test.ts', 'src/md_docs.test.ts', 'src/state_doc.test.ts', 'src/plugin_config.test.ts', 'src/skills_default.test.ts', 'src/outline_cast.test.ts', 'src/llm_client.test.ts', 'src/cast_analyzer.test.ts', 'src/deai_ledger.test.ts', 'src/inspiration.test.ts', 'src/graph_layout.test.ts', 'src/typing_stats.test.ts', 'src/chapter_moves.test.ts', 'src/sensitive_words.test.ts', 'src/chat_session.test.ts', 'src/chat_refs.test.ts', 'src/chat_tools.test.ts']; buildSync({ entryPoints: entries, bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'esm', external: ['yaml'], outdir, outExtension: { '.js': '.mjs' }, tsconfig: 'tsconfig.json' }); execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--test', ...entries.map((e) => path.join(outdir, e.replace('src/', '').replace('.ts', '.mjs')))], { stdio: 'inherit' }); fs.rmSync(outdir, { recursive: true, force: true });"
